notes: Where each modelled pavilion sits. source=osm: surviving building, position and orientation from its modern OSM footprint. source=map: demolished, centre and long axis read off the 1967 souvenir map (pixels) and pushed through the panel transform. Optional 'anchor' is a nearby surviving building drawn in the same complex: the map->local offset at the anchor (OSM centroid minus transformed map pixel) is applied to this pavilion as a local correction. Dimensions do NOT come from the map (the illustration exaggerates sizes); they live in the web/src/pavilions/*.js builders with their sources.
